observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-C97EB06D03E2EC] exactly: A model API call consists of the initial attempt plus at most 10 automatic retries. The delay is `500 ms × 2^(attempt-1)` with 0–25% positive jitter and a 32-second local cap.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-8DFA5468ACD416] exactly: A valid `Retry-After` may override local backoff, but a normal automatic wait is capped at 60 seconds. Values beyond that boundary leave the call in an actionable state instead of silently blocking for an unbounded period.

observe typed IPC or service API boundary after the trigger and assert [REQ-07B850FB24091F] exactly: Retry classification is explicit. User cancellation, deterministic authentication/permission/in

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-C8201DBE643FA9] exactly: Each new model API call receives its own retry budget. A next call made after a committed tool result therefore starts with a fresh budget, while the completed tool remains committed and is not executed again.

observe case-owned durable database state after the trigger and assert [REQ-148DE5A1747D3F] exactly: ZiqDo session JSONL remains the sole client-side durable source for recovery. New versioned records cover tool intent, committed tool result, cancellation intent, locally persisted model result, delivery ACK pending, and delivery ACK comple

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-E108D45D044111] exactly: A tool intent is recorded before execution. A tool result is committed before the runtime tells any consumer that the tool is safely complete. If execution may have started but the result cannot be proven, the effect is unknown and automati

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-61DCF26C0F9F37] exactly: Incomplete assistant text and incomplete `tool_use` from a failed attempt are not conversation checkpoints. Committed tool results are checkpoints and remain in the next model context.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-6C6B3125BD4FAE] exactly: A managed logical call has externally observable phases equivalent to generating, replayable, acknowledged, cancelled, expired, and failed. Implementations may map them onto existing persistence states, but must preserve their transition an

observe typed IPC or service API boundary after the trigger and assert [REQ-DF8C696BCDD616] exactly: When generation completes within 16 MiB, qwork_server stores the full encrypted response and an authenticated delivery receipt. Reconnecting with the same logical call replays that response and never starts a new upstream generation.

observe session/sidecar event stream after the trigger and assert [REQ-A781129719C62C] exactly: QWork shows the final response after ZiqDo persists and reads it back locally. Server ACK is asynchronous, idempotent, and restart-safe. ACK failure never hides the response, changes the task to failed, or starts a model retry.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-64BFC19BB0A1A1] exactly: ACK success settles QWork Credits once and removes the replay body immediately. If no ACK arrives within 1 hour, qwork_server deletes the body, releases or avoids the user charge, and retains only content-free audit metadata.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-F244DC8A0D1AC0] exactly: Downstream transport loss and explicit cancellation are distinct. Transport loss does not cancel the managed upstream call. Explicit cancellation is durably recorded by ZiqDo, stops local retries, and is delivered idempotently to qwork_serv

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-123D69DF717B42] exactly: qwork_server aborts or voids a cancelled result, removes replay content, and does not settle Credits. If the cancel message cannot be delivered immediately, ZiqDo does not ACK or consume replay and resends cancellation after reconnect.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-CDC4BF10E5D680] exactly: The 16 MiB response limit applies to ordinary managed responses, streaming accumulation, and replay bodies. Crossing the limit is a deterministic failure: remove uncommitted visible text, do not retry, do not downgrade, and do not charge us

observe session/sidecar event stream after the trigger and assert [REQ-A065885008A20C] exactly: During automatic retry, QWork replaces the failed attempt's uncommitted content in place with a running status that shows attempt count, limit, countdown, and cancel. No failure card appears before the retry budget ends.

observe typed return value and side-effect ledger after the trigger and assert [REQ-5395D97C28271E] exactly: On successful recovery, QWork replaces the retry status with one complete persisted reply. On cancellation, it states that unfinished content was not saved. Unknown tool effect exposes verification/details rather than the ordinary retry act

observe case-owned execution trace after the trigger and assert [REQ-A1DD162DA9A0D5] exactly: Operational events include trace, logical call, transport attempt, error class, retry ordinal, replay outcome, ACK outcome, cancellation, expiry, and settlement status. They exclude user content and secrets.

observe case-owned durable database state after the trigger and assert [REQ-9FC1E5ADA895C5] exactly: Release rollback disables the negotiated recovery capability. Existing JSONL records remain readable, existing ACK/cancel operations drain safely, and replay bodies expire normally; rollback never deletes committed tool results or billing a
